    Corollary 10.5 with the residual characters in W(P) #

    cor:zero-supported-coverage (integral-deformations.tex): "Assume the smaller-table lifting hypothesis of Theorem 9.1. Then every nonzero line HH²(A₀)_{χ_i}, with i ∈ I₀, has a nonzero representative supported on composable pairs (r, s) with rs = 0 and r * s ≠ 0 […]. Its value at such a pair lies in the line U_{r*s}."

    The statement of Char2A0.Cor105 and its proof (Cor105A0.lean) for an arbitrary mesh weight W with values in a lattice and a degree map (Cor105G, IStarG, cor105G_of_IStar; the characters are only required to be primitive), and the instance for A₀ of a basic connected representation-finite algebra in characteristic two with the characters in L = W(P) (IndSkeleton.zeroSupportedCoverage_WP): Proposition 10.3 for this weight by the generic MeshWalk.istar with the prime-field table, and primitivity from the integer basis of Proposition 7.5.

        Corollary 10.5 (cor:zero-supported-coverage) with the residual characters in W(P): for a basic connected representation-finite algebra in characteristic two, under the smaller-table lifting hypothesis of Theorem 9.1 (LiftBelow), for the rows of Proposition 6.1 and the universal mesh weight, every row with a nonzero class in HH²(A₀)_{χ_i} (i ∈ I₀) has a non-coboundary representative supported on the pairs with zero product and nonzero stem product, with values in the stem lines (Cor105G).
